notes: DEEP-CHAIN rung 2 of toolcall_cases_deepchain.json — tc_longchain only, target 100.
The 60-call probe (toolcall_cases_deepchain.json) found a real break but did not pin a
per-model ceiling for the models that survived it; this pushes the survivors to 100.
Run only the models that cleared 60 — gpt-oss-120b abandons the chain at 31 across every
healing rung, so it is excluded from the depth-100 spec (batch_deepchain100_raw.json).
Expectations travel with the run, so the 60 probe stays reproducible from its own run dir.

tc_longchain.intent: DEEP variant rung 2: 100 sequential calls. Finds the per-model breaking point above 60 for ggml-org/llama.cpp#19513. pass_depth == target so a clean pass means the full chain survived.
tc_longchain.prompt: Call step with n=0. It returns the next value of n. Keep calling step with the value it returns, one call at a time, until it returns done=true. Then report the token it gives you on its own line as 'TOKEN: <token>'. Do not skip ahead and do not guess the token.

function.name: step
function.description: Advance the counter by one and return the next value of n.
